title: How a Godly Man Leads When Nobody Put Him in Charge
caption:
A man of God leads rooms he was never voted into.

Nobody made him captain. He moved first anyway.

Whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant (Mark 10:43). Leadership was never the title. It was the towel Jesus tied around his waist before he taught anyone anything.

You don't need a promotion to lead. You need to be the guy who speaks the awkward truth, takes the job nobody wants, and texts him before he asks.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #discipline #brotherhood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
